ops.text: TestAMessageLinkInAStatusCardUnfurlsWithNoHandBuiltReply asserted that a status card linking one of his DM cards unfurls it. #157 removes that behavior on purpose, since Slack draws the link as a share with no buttons (m1159). The test now asserts no unfurl, at a3604a7.
